articles.headline: Untold stories of Detroit Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown's German upbringing
articles.description: For Amon-Ra St. Brown, Sunday's NFL game in Munich marked the ultimate convergence of his dual heritage. Here are stories that shed more light.

images.caption: St. Brown wears decals of both the German and American flags on his helmet.
images.alt: Amon-Ra St. Brown

images.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown (Germany) [2500x1667]
images.caption: St. Brown has put on football camps in Germany since becoming a pro in 2021.
images.credit: Federico Gambarini/picture alliance via Getty Images

images.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown (Helmet) [2500x1594]
images.caption: St. Brown says he's fortunate and proud to be so immersed in both cultures, each of which he's drawn from throughout his life.

images.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown (Mom) [1296x861]
images.caption: St. Brown's mother Miriam is from Leverkusen. He and his brothers made yearly summer trips to visit their grandparents in Germany.
